name: Harvard Alumni World Mastercard

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months on purchases and balance transfers (2% balance transfer fee), then standard APR as low as 13.24% to 18.00%.

credit_required.notes: Exclusively for Harvard alumni; includes membership in Harvard FCU.

base_rate.description: 1 point per dollar on all other purchases ($1 back per $100 spent).

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeem for cash back as a statement credit or Harvard FCU deposit; 25% more value when redeemed for travel. Points do not expire while the account is open.

signup_bonus.description: 10,000 bonus points after $500 in purchases in the first 90 days of card membership.

notes: Issued by Harvard Federal Credit Union.
